courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 地下水屏障防止海水入侵
related.transfer: 可遷移「入滲量與地下水補注量」與「水質混合與質量負荷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；地下水屏障防止海水入侵的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Infiltration versus aquifer recharge" and "Water-quality mixing and mass loading" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦包氣帶儲存、分層阻抗、補注監測與回收效率；地下水屏障防止海水入侵則以密度水頭、補注屏障、分層監測與鹽度傳輸為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on vadose storage, layered resistance, recharge monitoring and recovery efficiency; Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion centres on density heads, recharge barriers, layered monitoring and salinity transport, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「入滲量與地下水補注量」與「密度差與理想淡鹹水界面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到地下水屏障防止海水入侵，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「注入能力衰減與成因辨識」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Infiltration versus aquifer recharge” and “Density contrast and an ideal fresh-saline interface”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Groundwater barriers against seawater intrusion, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Declining injectivity and causal diagnosis", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地下水人工補注設施
history.text: 人工補注不是單純把水倒入地下，而是水源處理、地表設施、包氣帶與含水層共同作用的系統。橘郡GWRS官方問答記錄2008年啟用，並在2015與2023年擴建，提供水回用與地下水管理的背景。USGS於2013年發表Sand Hollow補注研究，利用水力及水化學資料探討氣體相關效應。兩者不是相同地質或相同處理系統，本課以比較方式學習證據如何支持判斷，所有簡式參數均為獨立假設，不將案例成果直接移植到未調查的場址。
history.textEn: Managed recharge links source treatment, surface facilities, the vadose zone and aquifers. OCWD records GWRS commissioning in 2008 and expansions in 2015 and 2023 as context for reuse and groundwater management. A USGS Sand Hollow study published in 2013 examines gas-related effects using hydraulic and hydrochemical observations. These examples have different geology and treatment arrangements. The course compares how evidence supports interpretation while keeping all simplified-model parameters hypothetical rather than transferring case outcomes to an uninvestigated site.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「入滲量與地下水補注量」到「停供期間、容量與長期水量帳」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Infiltration versus aquifer recharge" through "Supply interruptions, capacity and long-term accounting" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
